bug.title: Session verification display not identical across panels after component handoff
bug.description: After a component handoff between any of the three components (FindCare, EvaluateCare, SharedServices), the receiving component creates a fresh nonce. The right panel updates with the verified token but the left panel still shows the old nonce. Both panels must display identical session verification: same header, same nonce, same GUID, same verified status. There are 6 possible handoffs (n*(n-1) = 3*2 = 6): (1) FindCare to EvaluateCare, (2) FindCare to SharedServices, (3) EvaluateCare to FindCare, (4) EvaluateCare to SharedServices, (5) SharedServices to FindCare, (6) SharedServices to EvaluateCare. Each must produce identical session verification in both panels.
bug.fix: After each component handoff returns a verified token, send gui:session-display with the full session_token object. Update the handler to use buildTokenDisplayHtml() for identical display. Applies to all three components: FindCare, EvaluateCare, SharedServices. Permutations formula n*(n-1) = 3*2 = 6 possible handoffs. The Playwright smoke test must verify session identity after each: (1) FindCare to EvaluateCare, (2) FindCare to SharedServices, (3) EvaluateCare to FindCare, (4) EvaluateCare to SharedServices, (5) SharedServices to FindCare, (6) SharedServices to EvaluateCare.

bug.title: Cursor not focused on dialogue box after return to FindCare
bug.description: When control returns to FindCare from EvaluateCare or SharedServices, the cursor is not automatically placed in the chat input dialogue box. The user must manually click the input to type. This is governed by the RestoreState API field in the handoff — when RestoreState is false (default), FindCare resets to splash screen with cursor auto-focused.
